on the narrowest viewport in rtl locales the terminal still carries its Y translated view, but it doesn't in ltr locales. it should not be present in the either text direction.

Found it — the narrow-viewport media query flattens the tilt with plain `.gs-started__flipper` selectors, but the `:dir(rtl)` tilt rules earlier in the file have higher specificity (`:dir(rtl) .gs-started__flipper`), so they still win in RTL even inside the media query, leaving the rotateY tilt applied.

content.text: Fixed the specificity conflict: `:dir(rtl) .gs-started__flipper` (specificity 0,2,0) was overriding the plain `.gs-started__flipper` reset (0,1,0) inside the narrow-viewport media query, so RTL kept its `rotateY(15deg)`/`rotateY(-165deg)` tilt even below 959px. Added matching `:dir(rtl)` flattening rules inside that media query.
